_doc: GALVIS launch film soundtrack (real-sound format, audio/tools/mix.py). The score is composed in code and played from University of Iowa MIS recordings (audio/score -> audio/out/music.wav); the sound effects are real Mixkit recordings placed on the picture's cue events by one fragment per category in audio/design/ (prefixes im. tr. ui. mo.). audio/build.py renders the score, mixes, masters, encodes audio/soundtrack.m4a and writes audio/CREDITS.md. A listed fragment that is not on disk yet is left out by build.py (it says so), so every fragment joins the mix on its own once merged.
_music_doc: The score is rendered on the film's own grid (120 BPM, bar 1 at 0.0 s, 120.0 s long), so it plays untouched as one segment from 0: no stretch, no edit. The first note sounds at 0.0 (sound from the first frame) and opens on a 50 ms fade, so sample 0 does not click (qa: first 5 ms under -40 dBFS); the score fades itself out over 119.2-120.

segments.label: the whole score, bars 1-60, on the picture's grid

_buses_doc: Fader rides, film seconds -> dB. (1) 22.0-23.75, the riser into 24.0: the score's cymbal-roll swell and the SFX riser climb in the same 5-8 kHz band (qa read the riser only +4.6 dB over the bed), so the music steps 2 dB down on the bar line at 22.0 and the riser leads; it comes back inside the stop-down hole (music is silent there). Not at 56.0: that riser already reads +8.3 dB. (2) Act 06 (62-76): the music dips 3 dB under the typing and clicks from the bar line at 66.0 (first key, first word) to the bar line at 76.0 (act 07 wipe), each step a 50 ms ramp into the bar line so it hides under that downbeat's transient; the UI peaks then sit about 10 dB under the act's music peak, 13 dB under it before the dip. (3) The end card: the recordings of the 116.0 chord run out about 118.2 while the score holds the chord to 120, so the bus lifts 3.5 dB over 117.6-118.6 to keep the chord at body level under the URL (118.0), then fades out over 118.9-119.4, with the picture going black at 119.2 (earshot: fade under 1 s, final moment at body level). EQ: a 2.5 dB low shelf at 60 Hz on the music: Iowa MIS has no bass drum, so the score's sub share sat just under the reference films' range (earshot critique: sub 20-60 Hz -17.8 dB, refs from -17.7 dB).
_master_doc: -14 LUFS integrated for web / social. The ceiling is the starting point: build.py lowers it until the AAC 192k encode measures <= -1.5 dBTP. Bass folded to mono below 120 Hz (spec).
